programme.title: Quanzhou Puppet Theater: China’s "Pinocchio Adventure"
programme.desc: In the film, the puppet Pinocchio, carved and created by an old carpenter, comes to life as a real human. Puppets are lifeless by nature—it is the masterful skills of their puppeteers’ fingertips that breathe life into them. What does China’s own "Pinocchio Adventure" look like? This episode takes you into the world of Quanzhou String Puppet Theater. Explore behind-the-scenes stories, from the intricate carving of puppet heads to the art of puppet performance, and witness how the dance of ten fingers and threads weaves a thousand vivid characters to life!

programme.title: China Untapped: Changsha
programme.desc: The city of Changsha is one of central China's powerhouses. It's a leader in both the construction machinery industry and in media – Changsha was China's first UNESCO "Creative City". It's also one of China's best-known cities for its nightlife. programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: Culture Forward
programme.desc: Culture Forward is set at a pivotal moment between the close of China’s 14th Five-Year Plan and the launch of the 15th. The program explores how technology is giving culture new momentum, featuring cases such as Guizhou’s mechanized batik techniques, the digital presentation of Liangzhu culture, AI-powered design for Miao embroidery, and creative innovation at the Hunan Museum. Through real-world practices, it reveals how traditional Chinese culture is being revitalized in the age of intelligence—moving toward a future that is more open, innovative, and high-quality.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit.It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.

programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit.It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.

programme.title: China Untapped: Changsha
programme.desc: The city of Changsha is one of central China's powerhouses. It's a leader in both the construction machinery industry and in media – Changsha was China's first UNESCO "Creative City". It's also one of China's best-known cities for its nightlife. The soul of a city is in its people, and this episode focuses on the women of Changsha who are helping to innovate, change and further develop this city they call home.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along...

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.4
programme.desc: Shaanxi, almost right in the middle of China, is a true land of contrasts. South of the Qinling Mountains that divide the province, the terrain has all the allure of south China, while north of this great dividing range lies the Guanzhong Plain and the austere and otherworldly Loess Plateau. Join us for a journey into a province that presents two equally beautiful and fascinating faces to the world!

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes.In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes.In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.”The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests...

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world.In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress.Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions....

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake...

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.4
programme.desc: Shaanxi, almost right in the middle of China, is a true land of contrasts. South of the Qinling Mountains that divide the province, the terrain has all the allure of south China, while north of this great dividing range lies the Guanzhong Plain and the austere and otherworldly Loess Plateau. Join us for a journey into a province that presents two equally beautiful and fascinating faces to the world!

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.4
programme.desc: Shaanxi, almost right in the middle of China, is a true land of contrasts. South of the Qinling Mountains that divide the province, the terrain has all the allure of south China, while north of this great dividing range lies the Guanzhong Plain and the austere and otherworldly Loess Plateau. Join us for a journey into a province that presents two equally beautiful and fascinating faces to the world!

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes.In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.”The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests...

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Five Ancestors Fist
programme.desc: In Quanzhou, southeast China, Kleber seeks out masters of the Five Ancestors Fist, a combination of five local kungfu styles. He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou’s traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane

After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council.The county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been...

Coralie and Florent are still walking on clouds as they wait for their daughter, Lena. So are Nathalie and Naoufel, who arrange a tour of the future baby’s bedroom. Things are still tense between Kim and her parents. Her father blames here for having left school too early and the family makes no effort to hide their dislike of Pierre, the would-be father, who is still a no-show. They go as far as opposing Kim’s preferred choice for the future boy’s name, since it was his father that came up with the idea...

Was Coralie allowed her much-desired epidural? Did Pierre came back at Kim’s side to finally act as the father, and what name did Kim settle upon for her son? In the end, it is Nathalie and Naoufel, our most experienced parents, who share with us some words of wisdom: “one isn’t just born being a parent, one has to learn it.”

programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Nature’s Heroes: Gabon - Part 1
programme.desc: How can we reconcile the development needed to sustain the lives of nearly seven billion people with the protection of the Earth's natural resources? Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team have chosen Gabon to continue their survey of the planet. We'll be discovering the Kongou Falls, the Langoué clearing with their elephant in Gabon. Then in Colombia, we will go on the island of Malpelo with their shark. Back to Gabon we will discover the Minkébé National Park and the bats in Franceville. We will also go to India in Hyderabad, which has convinced farmers to use no pesticides and no GMOs in their cultivation.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Citrus flavors
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Carine (Nice)
programme.desc: After twenty years as a lawyer, Carine decided to give in to her desire to help others heal. Her inner journey led her to discover a passion for naturopathy as she rediscovered her love for nature and learned the healing qualities of the plants around her. Combined with a deep understanding of astrology and nutrition, she is now able to help others live better and find their own path.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Virginie (Lyon)
programme.desc: Virginie’s beautiful handwritten lettering decorates the walls and windows of many shops in and around Lyon, France, as she lives out her passion of finding beauty in every stroke. A former waitress, Virginie was struggling to find her calling when she suffered a life-altering horse accident that almost left her handicapped. At only 30, she was forced to put her whole life into perspective. She finally found herself through a love for graphic design and lettering, combined with a desire for freedom that came with working independently. To motivate other women, she has also launched “Ladyboss”, a network of inspiring women entrepreneurs.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Laetitia (French Alps)
programme.desc: While pregnant with her daughter, Laetitia, a former journalist, experienced a strong desire to change lifestyles and move to the countryside. Remembering the teachings of her grandmother, she began to venture outdoors into the surrounding Alps and study the different plants at her fingertips. Today she holds a wealth of knowledge about the medicinal and aromatherapeutic value of plants that she applies to making natural products. With utmost respect for the environment, Laetitia gathers only what she needs in order to make herbal infusions.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Louise (Oleron Island)
programme.desc: At only 20 years old, Louise is full of confidence and already achieved a personal dream of hers to share her passion for nutritious and locally-sourced ingredients on the island of Oleron, France. Repurposing a camping car, she set up a brunch and tea-time spot where the guests can hand-pick their ingredients in the adjacent organic fields. Louise transforms the ingredients into favourite creations of hers and even joins her father for boat trips when she needs to stock up on fresh fish for the menu!

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 3 - Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 1
programme.desc: In this instalment, Yann Arthus-Bertrand lifts the veil on the products people buy. Almost everything we buy has a direct impact on our environment. We head to Japan to talk about the impact of new technologies, then to the Republic of Congo in Bukavu for the coltan harvest. How does our total consumption affect the environment? What permanent brands are we imposing on our planet? How can we differentiate between useful and useless purchases?

In Cadiz, an ancient Phoenician city, they soak in sweeping Atlantic views and a corniche with hints of North Africa. This episode immerses viewers in the culture, history, and vibrant spirit of one of Spain’s most enchanting regions.

programme.desc: The tale of Psyche, a mortal of extraordinary beauty, sparks the jealousy of Venus, who sends her son Cupid to curse her with a monstrous love. Instead, Psyche captures Cupid's heart, but her betrayal of his trust breaks their fragile bond. Determined to reunite with him, Psyche endures a series of divine trials. In the end, the gods grant her immortality, and their love prevails—an enduring myth of trust, redemption, and the power of true devotion.

programme.title: Opera - Salome

The performance blends Strauss's intense musical drama with a fresh and dynamic staging.

programme.desc: Jack pushes Yuya to his limits in the Friendship Cup finale! Does Yuya have the dueltaining skills to dethrone the Master of Faster, or will Jack’s rule reign supreme?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: With the City on the edge of their seats, a new champion is about to be crowned! But who will sit in the winner’s circle: Yuya or Jack?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The Friendship Cup may be over, but trouble sure isn’t! Roget is planning to take Zuzu to Duel Academy!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya reaches a new place - Heartland City, the hometown of Yuto and Shay in the Xyz Dimension along with Sylvio and Gong. There they meet Duel Academy soldiers and an independent warrior from that dimension.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 The Edge of the World
programme.desc: Yuma misplaces the the Emperor's Key that was an important momento from his parents. He and Astral look high and low for it, but they just can't seem to find it. While they look, Astral is curious as to how the Emperor's Key is related to Yuma's father. Yuma starts talking about various memories from his childhood that he remembers about his dad. Yuma's Never-Give-Up Spirit "Kattobingu" was born from a promise he made with his father.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 Roots of the Problem
programme.desc: Yuma safely recovers "Number 96: Black Mist" from a man. Tetsuo, who witnessed the Duel, takes note that Yuma seems suddenly more brutal in his strategy, and ends up in a fight with him. Not having reconciled in over 2 days, suddenly Number 96 swallows Yuma and Astral up!! To rescue Yuma and Astral from Number 96, Tetsuo fights the Numbers for the first time!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 Battle with the Bot
programme.desc: As they head home from class, Yuma and his friends meet Lilly who becomes their friend. However, after the robot is reprogrammed to its former self, Yuma duels Lilly in order to help regain her memories.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In order to protect Yuma's Key from Kite, Shark faces him in a Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E23 Hunting Down the Hunter - Part 1
programme.desc: While Yuma seeks for his Key, Astral duels against Kite to defend the Number cards he possesses.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E24 Hunting Down the Hunter - Part 2
programme.desc: Despite being unable to fight against the immense power of Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon, Astral, his resolve stern due to Feeling the Flow, continues a desperate combo of Offense and Defense. But when he finally gives up against Kite who keeps attacking him over and over, Yuma appears and the mysterious ZEXAL power activates...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: One morning, Yuma heads to school, and while talking to his friends, time stops. He sees three suns shining in the sky. Together with Astral, they both shiver from a fear they do not understand, causing Yuma to run off to find out what possibly could have happened. At that time, Kite, using Dr. Faker's technology, retraces Astral's memories and invites Yuma to the World Duel Carnival.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 Let the Duels Begin
programme.desc: The World Duel Carnival, where Duelists from around the world will wage heated battles, is swiftly approaching. Yuma, seeking to fulfill his dream of becoming "Duel Champion", excitedly rushes to the tournament. But what will Yuma do when he has no Heart Pieces, which serve as the proof of participation for the WDC? Meanwhile, Mr. Heartland and Kite make their preparations to gather the Numbers that are likely to assemble before them in this tournament.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma's first opponent in the World Duel Carnival is the soccer kid, Striker. Striker transforms the surrounding stadium with his Field Spell Card, as the Duel kicks off. With his "Offside Trap", Striker brilliantly seals Yuma's strategies, while his teammate monsters use teamwork to frantically keep beating Yuma up with a combo of offense and defense and with such sheer strength, it seems as if Striker's victory is decided...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: While looking for an opponent to Duel, Yuma meets a boy named Cody, who loves construction equipment, at a construction site. Yuma, interested in the construction equipment Deck Cody uses, challenges him to a Duel. However, Cody Xyz Summons his "Digvorzhak, King of Heavy Industry".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: While looking for an opponent to Duel, Yuma meets a boy named Cody, who loves construction equipment, at a construction site. Yuma, interested in the construction equipment Deck Cody uses, challenges him to a Duel. However, Cody Xyz Summons his "Digvorzhak, King of Heavy Industry".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E101 Realm of The Cipher Dragon
programme.desc: Gongenzaka and Sawatari fight against the mysterious Kaito, who believes them to be agents of Academia. As he summons his fearsome Galaxy Eyes Cipher Dragon, Yuto notes that something has changed in Kaito.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Kaito begins a merciless assault against Yuya with his powerful Galaxy Eyes deck. With Yuto's spirit on his side, Yuya tries to match Kaito's indomitable spirit with both Odd Eyes Pendulum Dragon and Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Kaito begins a merciless assault against Yuya with his powerful Galaxy Eyes deck. With Yuto's spirit on his side, Yuya tries to match Kaito's indomitable spirit with both Odd Eyes Pendulum Dragon and Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E103 Rise of the Resistance
programme.desc: Yuya and the others meet the Xyz Resistance, who discuss how Heartland fell to ruin and Yusho's mysterious connection to them. Elsewhere, in the Fusion Dimension, Yuzu flees Academia soldiers when someone unexpected comes to her rescue.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E104 Rumble in the Rubble
programme.desc: Yusho explains what happened during his disappearance to Yuzu while in the Fusion Dimension. Back in Heartland, Yuya comes across an angry youth with a grudge against his Dueltaining style as Yuto refuses to stand by any longer.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Shun is determined to convince Kaito to rejoin the Resistance despite Kaito's adamant refusal. As the former friends cannot convince each other either way, they decide all they can do is fight against each other.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yusho reveals that three years ago he learned of the Arc Area Project and Academia's machinations, going on a journey to stop Leo's plans. Yuri arrives at the You Show Duel School to stamp out the resistance against Academia.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Allen and Sayaka try to fight Kaito only to end up facing Grace and Gloria Tyler, two of Academia's strongest enforcers. Having no choice but to fight, they face off against the Tyler's Amazoness deck.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: As Sawatari and Gongenzaka both fail to defeat the Tyler sisters, Yuya and Shun arrive to meet their challenge. In the face of their near perfect combo, Yuya must not give into his rage and defeat his powerful foes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: As Sawatari and Gongenzaka both fail to defeat the Tyler sisters, Yuya and Shun arrive to meet their challenge. In the face of their near perfect combo, Yuya must not give into his rage and defeat his powerful foes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya and the others try to return to the Resistance base when they are attacked by the Obelisk Force. They try to face the power of the Obelisk Force when Shun becomes gravely injured during the battles.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Academia's enforcer Edo Phoenix challenges Yuya to a rematch. Torn between his allegiance to the Professor and his spirit of Dueltaining, a confused Edo is determined to crush Yuya and the ghost of Yusho that haunts him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: As their duel goes on, Edo only becomes more conflicted of where his allegiances lie. Seeing Edo suffer, Yuya is determined to remind him how fun dueling can be and begins his greatest Dueltaining performance yet.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Convincing Edo, the Tyler twins, and the rest of the forces in Heartland to join their side, Yuya and the other Lancers prepare to head to the Fusion Dimension to find their friends and restore everyone who has been turned into a card.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya encounters his old foe from the Junior Youth Championship, Kachidoki. Kachidoki continues to use violent tactics and powerful Fusions in his Action Duels as Yuya tries to return a smile to his heart.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E114 All Duel Hands on Deck
programme.desc: Yuya and co board a ship to Duel Academy when Dennis catches up to them, aiming to defeat Yusho once and for all. A still vengeful Kaito meets Dennis's challenge as the two unleash their greatest monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Serena, who appeared before the Lancers, suddenly betrays them and captures Yuzu while Yuya is forced to fight Captain Solo. Caught between useless cards and Solo's lock deck, things seem hopeless when more allies suddenly arrive.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yugo meets with up the others and agree to work together against Academia. Yugo and Kaito head to the towers where Rin and Ruri are being held captive, only to face the guardians Apollo and Diana.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E117 Grip of the Parasite
programme.desc: The Doctor has brainwashed Ruri and Rin, leading them to fight against Yugo and Kaito. Meanwhile, Reiji recounts how all of Yuya's counterparts as well as all the bracelet girls are part of Leo's ultimate plan: Revival Zero.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E118 Survival Of The Fittest
programme.desc: Yuya and the Lancers finally make it the Academy, but they are captured and thrown into a wild battle royale against the Obelisk Force. However, a mysterious enemy in the royale begins wiping out friend and foe alike.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Allie is looking to make a big splash at the Arc League Championship, but she soon finds herself in over her head! Can Allie's deck of fishy friends turn the tides, or will her mysterious opponent sink her chances of winning?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The wild duelist known as Battle Beast crushes his fellow Academy students and even turns Crow and Tsukikage into cards. Yuya and Gongenzaka arrive to face the challenge of their insane foe.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E121 Taming of The BB
programme.desc: Jack appears out of nowhere and joins Yuya in fighting against Battle Beast. Battle Beast's instructor, Sanders, joins in the duel as well to show the power and glory of the Academy to the Lancers.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Battle Beast continues his rampage against friend and foe alike. Sensing nothing but rage and anger in Battle Beast's heart, Yuya is determined to show him how fun dueling can actually be and aims to purge his demons.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Asuka stays behind to fight Yuri while Sora and the others go on ahead. Yuri uses a different deck and fights Asuka, who tries to reach out a helping hand to Yuri. That's when Yuri reveals the real reason why he does what he does.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya comes across Ruri, who is still under the control of the Doctor's parasites. Yuya attempts to fight off Ruri, made harder when Serena joins the fight. Yuto decides to take control and face the two girls.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E125 Rise Of The Parasites
programme.desc: Yuya and Yuto are struggling in their battle against Ruri and Serena and their Parasite Queen. The Doctor attempts to take control of Yuya using a parasite as well, but that only awakens the rage inside of Yuya once again.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Leo Akaba reveals to Yusho Sakaki how the four dimensions came to be.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Leo continues his story about how Zarc destroyed the original world. Leo's daughter Ray used four cards to stop Zarc and split the world into the four current worlds. He then reveals the true nature of Yuya, Yuzu, and the Arc Area Project.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Leo begins his final plan to fuse the dimensions and revive his daughter Ray. Reiji and Yuya team up to take down Leo, with Yuya resolving not to let Zarc be revived. Yusho realizes that even this is part of a larger enemy's plan.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Leo's plan gets further and further to completion, which causes the evil inside of Yuya to emerge once more. Yusho stops the duel and realizes that Zarc's influence is hovering over everything, including Yuya's other counterparts.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yugo and Yuri being their duel, with Zarc's shared influence forcing them into battle. To stop Zarc's revival, Kaito and Edo join the battle as well to hold back Yuri's powerful Fusion Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: While Yuri and Yugo continue their savage battle, Reira starts hearing the voice of Ray. Aiming to make sure Ray is revived, Reira stands against Reiji and the siblings begin a duel with each other.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Reiji manages to defeat Reira, continuing on to fight Leo. Elsewhere, Yuri absorbs Yugo and aims to defeat Yuya so that Zarc can be completed. Yusho stands in for his son to fight the depraved youth instead.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yusho's advanced Dueltaining manages to push Yuri into a corner and bring Yuya back to his old self. But Yuri is determined to complete Zarc's revival and has one nasty surprise in store for Yusho.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Seeing his father carded in front of his eyes, Yuya's rage reaches a boiling point as he accepts Yuri's challenge. But not only does he have to contend with Yugo and Yuri's dragons, but Zarc's ever growing influence over him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The four dimensions start to fuse together as Yuya continues to struggle against Yuri. Forced to discard his trump card, things seem hopeless. Yuya's friends then arrive to encourage him to keep fighting no matter what.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E136 A Most Brutal Duel
programme.desc: Yuya absorbs all of his counterparts and reclaimed his true form as Supreme King Z-ARC. Starting to lay waste to the Fusion Dimension, Sora and Edo challenge Zarc to try and reach out to Yuya's spirit.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The four dimensions continue to unite as Zarc effortlessly crushes Sora and Edo. Kaito and Shun continue the fight against Zarc while people from Heartland and Neo Domino City start appearing in the Fusion Dimension.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Gongenzaka and Jack fight against Zarc next, trying their best to reach out to Yuya's soul buried in Zarc's darkness. A revived Crow and Sawatari decide to join in when Zarc's Supreme King Dragons swarm the field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Crow notices that Zarc is starting to lose his composure, leading him and Sawatari to up their game against Zarc's dragons. As dimensional integration is getting closer to completion, Reiji tries to convince his dad to stop Zarc.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E140 A Ray of Hope
programme.desc: Ray's soul possesses Reira so she can battle against Zarc alongside Reiji. Zarc boasts that he is the creator of Pendulum Summon, but Ray is determined to stop him once and for all using the four natural energy cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E141 Swinging Back into Action
programme.desc: Things have seemingly returned to normal in the Pendulum Dimension, but Yuya gets the feeling that something is missing. Reiji has him duel against Tsukikage to restore his memories and make him finish the Lancer's goal for good.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The battle royale continues. As Yuya keeps fighting, his memories start flooding back to him. Yuzu's dad suddenly remembers too as the rest of the world slowly begins to remember the Lancers and the battle against Zarc.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Anna Kaboom attempts to kill Yuma with a cannon. He negotiates with her and they Duel instead so that Anna can try to take her revenge. Their past history is not what it initially seems.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Tombo Tillbitty Duels people, defeating them with his "Basket Rule" and takes their Heart Pieces. Dextra and Nistro appear near one of the defeated Duelists. They see he has vegetables stuffed in his mouth, and Dextra sees blood on his shirt. Dextra inspects closer, and licks it up, telling the disgusted Nistro it's just tomato juice.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E31 Life Is a Carnival - Part 1
programme.desc: Charlie McCay steals "Number 7: Lucky Straight" from a gallery. Kari, who has past history with Charlie, sends Yuma after him. He and Astral witness the power of the "Lucky Straight" when Charlie performs a One Turn Kill on a World Duel Carnival competitor. Charlie makes his escape, stealing more cards in the process, including one of Yuma's "Numbers".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E32 Life Is a Carnival - Part 2
programme.desc: Charlie McCay escapes on the single-track railroad and Yuma starts the Duel. But Charlie's "Number 7: Lucky Straight" possesses amazing luck. If he hits the jackpot by rolling the dice, then Charlie's Life Points will become 100,000. On the verge of giving up when all of his attempts to stop that strong luck become fruitless, Yuma discovers an unexpected strategy.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The second day of WDC starts. More energetic than ever, Bronk and Caswell decide to battle the Asian Duel Champion, Quattro. According to these two, the gentleman Quattro has a respectable Duel aesthetic, which is also admired by many Duelists from their hearts. Witnessed by Yuma, Astral, Tori and Trey, the Battle Royal between Quattro, Bronk, and Caswell starts, but Quattro soon reveals his true side which remained hidden until now.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Shark is determined to have his revenge on Quattro, but Quattro's younger brother Trey snares Shark with a Duel Anchor and allows Quattro to leave. Trey's mission from Vetrix and Quinton is to give a "Number" to Shark, which he accomplishes. Shark is able to resist completely being controlled by the "Number" and defeats Trey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Shark is determined to have his revenge on Quattro, but Quattro's younger brother Trey snares Shark with a Duel Anchor and allows Quattro to leave. Trey's mission from Vetrix and Quinton is to give a "Number" to Shark, which he accomplishes. Shark is able to resist completely being controlled by the "Number" and defeats Trey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After Yuma laments over Shark dueling in revenge against Quattro, he's irritated by everything that's going on and ends up getting into a squabble with Tori. Meanwhile, elsewhere in the tournament, a photographer named Cameron has won Duel after Duel against Duelists with the help of terrifying ability of his that leaves them in terror. Cameron's superpower is apparently a gift to be able to take photographs of the future. With Cameron's "Future Photographs", his opponent's entire strategy is laid bare before him, allowing him to relentlessly defeat Duelists.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma is having trouble in his Duel against Cameron, and the dangerous future of Tori encountering an accident is continuously approaching. Then, "Number 25: Force Focus", controlled by Cameron, finally shows up. Yuma cannot win without Summoning "Utopia", but according to the prophecy, Yuma will lose in this Duel for sure if he Summons it. Under this desperate circumstance, in order to grasp the future within his own hands, Yuma delivers a bold strategy!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In order to prevent Flip from being disqualified from the WDC, Yuma Duels against Dextra and Nistro. Meanwhile, Astral faces against an old enemy inside Emperor's Key.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The Duel between Yuma against Dextra and Nistro continues. Due to their combination, Yuma is pushed into a corner, even after Summoning "Utopia" thanks to Astral. However due to the bonds between the two, a reversal occurs!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Reiji reveals that Zarc is still alive and Reira is barely holding back his malevolence. The world must be united and Yuya must purge Zarc's evil once and for all. Yuya is unsure. but Gongenzaka attempts to ignite his fighting spirit.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya arrives in the Xyz Dimensions with Dennis as his next opponent. Threatening to turn the traumatized citizens of Heartland into cards again, Dennis forces Yuya into a duel against him and his Xyz/Fusion mix.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya arrives in the Fusion Dimension where he finds a distraught Shun. Like with Yuya's counterparts, Ruri and the others have not been resurrected following Ray's revival. Yuya tries to calm Shun down only to end up the target of his fury.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E146 One Way Street to Defeat
programme.desc: Jack appears to taunt Yuya over his fear of using his counterpart's dragons in fear of summoning Zarc. Unable to accomplish anything as is, Yuya challenges Jack to a duel while Reiji makes it so everyone can watch the battle.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya finally listens to his other selves and summons all four of his dragons to defeat Jack. However, there is one final challenge before him in order to become a Dueltainer and purge Zarc: his rival and friend Reiji Akaba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The curtain is about to fall for the last time. The final battle between Yuya and Reiji rages on. Dragons face off against D/D/D as the whole world watches. What will be the final fate of Yuya, Yuzu, and all four dueling dimensions?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma's Heart Pieces are stolen by Pip, and Cathy Duels to get them back.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: To heal his little brother Hart's illness, Kite rigorously continues hunting the "Number" cards. Seeing his older brother exhausted, Hart sneaks away from Heartland and into Heartland City, and by chance meets Yuma, Astral and Tori. Amazingly, Hart can see Astral, who in turn seems to know Hart's name. Moved by Astral's wish, Yuma takes Hart to his home. After Hart escaped from the Heartland Tower, he is chased by Dextra and Nistro in a helicopter which results in them going to a tower in order to meet Kite. Soon after, a helicopter appears, in which Hart, Yuma and Tori think it is Nistro and Dextra, resulting in Hart using his Dark Energy. After Yuma calms Hart down with a piece of...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Hart is kidnapped by the Vetrix Family and so Kite and Yuma join forces. However when they find their hideout, they're forced into a Tag Duel against Quattro and Trey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The Tag Duel of Yuma and Kite against Quattro and Trey begins! Kite duels essentially on his own, even to the extent of hurting all of his opponents, including Yuma. However, Yuma on his part, defends himself and Kite from Trey and Quattro's damaging combination. Furthermore, even with "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" being Summoned, it falls victim to Quattro and Trey's trap.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Due to the terror of Trey and Quattro's strategy, Kite and Yuma are pushed into a corner. However at the edge of defeat, Hart's feelings awaken a new power inside Kite. With it, he Summons the monster created by the powerful bonds between them, "Neo Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E44 Rock and a Hard Place
programme.desc: Yuma finds himself in conflict about the "Number" cards, knowing that both Kite and Astral have their reasons for obtaining them. However upon learning that his father is still alive, Yuma tries to leave in search for him. Roku appears to help Yuma with his situation.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The third day of the preliminaries begins with Yuma looking for one more Heart Piece. Meanwhile, Nistro who wants to defeat Yuma and Astral, enters the tournament along with Dextra. Consequently while collecting Heart Pieces, Nistro challenges Nelson Andrews.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After watching the quick Duel between Yuma against Shark, Trey visits Yuma's house in order to learn more about him. He finds a picture of Yuma's parents, and starts thinking about how his family used to be. He becomes very upset and cries, then runs out of Yuma's house. Yuma goes after him, but then Trey gives him a map, and leaves.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Using new powers given to him by Vetrix, Trey is able to break Yuma and Astral's combination. After capturing Astral, Trey makes Yuma forget about "kattobingu" leading him into further trouble as this makes the latter unable to see Astral or Emperor's Key.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Due to Trey's power, Yuma forgets all about "Kattobing" and ends up forced into a corner. However Kazuma, helps Yuma continue the fierce Duel against Trey by using the power of the "Numbers" and Emperor's Key to break Trey's spell. Lastly Astral's last hope helps Yuma make a comeback by using "Utopia".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The Duel between Yuma and Trey comes to an end as in order to stop "Atlandis", Trey cooperates with Yuma in order to bring Astral back. Once that occurs, the power of ZEXAL is used once more in order to Summon "ZW - Phoenix Bow" and defeat "Atlandis".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma and his friends get all decked out for the event of the year - the World Duel Carnival Finals party! But when Yuma forgets his invite, can he find a way into the festivities, or will he be forced to hit the road and head home early?!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: It’s time for the World Duel Carnival Finals! But prepare for a world of twists and turns because the finalists will be dueling on a roller coaster! Can Yuma handle the ups and downs of the competition, or will he be sent for a loop?!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: To assess Yuma’s dueling skills, Vetrix hires the Triad of Terror, a trio of cunning card sharks, to triple team him! Yuma better figure out a way to roll through this threesome before his dueling goes off the rails!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The World Duel Carnival takes a dark turn as the finalists descend into the Dragon’s Den – a dark and dangerous duel track that will bring defeat for many a duelist! Can Yuma make his way through the treacherous track, or will the Dragon’s Den deliver a knockout blow?!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S02 : E54 Welcome to the Jungle

programme.desc: I 1895 anklages kaptajn Alfred Dreyfus (Louis Garrel), en ung og lovende officer, for spionage til tyskerne og dømmes til livsvarigt fængsel på Djævleøen. Dreyfus' ydmygelse følges også af Georges Picquart (Jean Dujardin), der er blevet forfremmet til at lede kontraespionagenheden.

programme.title: Palo Alto
programme.desc: High School-eleverne Teddy, April, Fred og Emily er ligesom alle andre på jagt efter noget at lave i Palo Altos kedelige forstadsmiljø.

programme.title: Brain On Fire
programme.desc: SUSANNAH CAHALAN er en ung kvinde, som lige er blevet færdig med sin universitetsuddannelse og nu udlever sine drømme i New York City. Hun er en spirende journalist på New York Post, og hun forelsker sig i musikeren STEPHEN.

programme.title: The Conversation
programme.desc: Baseret på en virkelig hændelse. I juni 1945 mødes to magtfulde mænd med stærkt modsatrettede filosofier og syn på deres lands fremtid.

programme.title: 99 Moons
programme.desc: Erotisk og grænseoverskridende. Da Bigna og Frank, der er meget forskellige, mødes, opstår der en erotisk gnist, som ikke dør ud med det samme. Bigna er 28 år. Hun arbejder som forsker og er besat af at have kontrol.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Boys on the Side
programme.desc: Efter at have begået en forbrydelse ved et uheld, tager tre kvinder på en rejse tværs over landet, der hjælper dem med at finde tilhørsfølelse og venskab.

programme.title: Another Day of Life
programme.desc: Året er 1975 og Angola hærges af borgerkrig. Militære faktioner strides om kontrollen af den nyligt uafhængige koloni. Den polske journalist Ryszard Kapuscinski ankommer for at dække konflikten.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Efter seks år som soldat i Den Amerikanske Borgerkrig vender en venligere og mere betænksom soldat hjem til sin gård og kone, som ellers troede, han var død. En skuffet bejler afslører, at manden er en bedrager, og at den rigtige Sommersby er efterlyst for mord.

programme.title: Mothers and Daughters
programme.desc: Højt oppe i toppen af en ejendom på Manhattan kigger den smarte og tilfredse singlepige Rigby Gray ind i sine naboers lejligheder og liv i sikkert skjul bag sin lange kameralinse og uvidende om, at hendes liv snart vil blive forandret for altid.

programme.title: My Week With Marilyn
programme.desc: Marilyn Monroe er det forrige århundredes absolut største kvindelige ikon og er omgivet af en nærmest mytisk aura. Nu vækkes hun til live i 'My Week With Marilyn', der er baseret på virkelige hændelser.

programme.title: The Queen
programme.desc: Diana, "Folkets Prinsesse", er død i en bilulykke i Paris. Dronningen (Dame Helen Mirren) og hendes familie beslutter, at de for det bedste bør forblive skjult bag de lukkede døre på Balmoral Castle.

programme.title: Bekas
programme.desc: Det er de tidlige 90’ere og Saddam Husseins regime har lagt et stort pres på den kurdiske del af Irak. To hjemløse kurdiske drenge ser Superman i byens første biograf og beslutter sig for at tage til Amerika. For at komme dertil har de har brug for pas, penge og en masse held.

programme.title: The Last Bus
programme.desc: Da en ældre mands hustru går bort, rejser han gennem Skotland og England med bus for at opfylde sit løfte om at sprede hendes aske tæt på deres første fælles hjem.

programme.title: Auggie
programme.desc: Følelsen af ensomhed fører førtidspensionisten Felix længere ind i en virtuel virkelighed og længere bort fra virkeligheden og hans familie.

programme.title: Elegy
programme.desc: Den aldrende litteraturprofessor David lever alene og har en forkærlighed for unge studerende. En dag møder han den smukke Consuela og forfører hende uden seriøse hensigter. Efterhånden uddybes deres forhold, og den gamle kyniker opdager pludselig, at han er forelsket.

programme.title: Lonely Hearts
programme.desc: Lonely Hearts er en fængslende historie om seriemordere på flugt, som er baseret på Martha Beck og Raymond Fernandez' mordtogt i slutningen af 1940erne, og kriminalbetjent Elmer C. Robinsons medvirken i deres tilfangetagelse, fængsling og efterfølgende henrettelse.

programme.title: Management
programme.desc: Man kan komme langt på et glas champagne og et klap bagi! En frustreret forretnings-kvinde på salgstur? Og en kikset motelbestyrer med smag for billig champagne og runde bagdele? Ikke nogen vinder-kombination, men meget kan ske på et ensomt motorvejshotel...

programme.title: Maybe Baby
programme.desc: En komedie om et par (Hugh Laurie og Joely Richardson), der forsøger at undfange et barn.

programme.title: Vampires Suck
programme.desc: En vampyrparodi med masser af blodige jokes!Becca, en ængstelig teenager, som ligeer begyndt på en nye skole, føler sigsplittet mellem sine følelser for deto overnaturlige bejlere: en lunefuldvampyr og en ægte behåret varulv.

programme.title: Growing Up and Other Lies
programme.desc: Efter flere års kamp som kunstner i New York beslutter Jake at sige stop og flytte hjem til Ohio. På sin sidste dag i byen overtaler han sine tre bedste venner til at et begive sig ud på et sidste stort eventyr sammen med ham: en gåtur hele vejen ned gennem Manhattan.

programme.title: The People We Hate at the Wedding
programme.desc: I denne hysterisk frække komedie bliver de dysfunktionelle amerikanske søskende Alice og Paul – sammen med deres altid optimistiske mor – inviteret til det britiske bryllup for deres fjerne halvsøster, Eloise, som en chance for at genoprette forbindelsen som voksne og lære at elske hinanden som før.

programme.title: The High School Conspiracy
programme.desc: Løgn, korruption, intriger, bedrag. Alt sammen inden spisefrikvarteret! Bobby Funke er skolebladsskribent på St. Donovan's High School og på jagt efter en historie!

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: Da Marmaduke flytter til et nyt kvarter med sin familie, opdager den kæmpestore teenage-hund hurtigt, at han bare ikke passer ind – bogstaveligt talt! Men med hjælp fra sin bedste ven, katten Carlos, og nogle nye, firbenede venner lykkes det måske alligevel Marmaduke at komme ud af hundehuset...

programme.title: Movie 43
programme.desc: Luk øjnene og hold dig for ørerne! Peter Farrelly, som gav os "Vild Med Mary" og "Dum & Dummere", har samlet det vildeste skuespillerhold til en film, der bryder ALLE grænser! Det er muligvis ikke god smag... men det er helt sikkert gode grin!

programme.title: The Beaver
programme.desc: I The Beaver leverer Mel Gibson (dobbelt Oscar-vinder) en sublim skuespilspræstation som den depressive virksomhedsleder Walter Black, hvis familieliv, ægteskab og karriere skranter gevaldigt.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: I jagten på en undsluppet fange går agent Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) undercover som en overdimensioneret, strid bedstemor fra Sydstaterne med en indstilling så hård som hendes koteletter!

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2
programme.desc: FBI agenten Malcolm Turner (Lawrence) har nu skrivebordsjob, kone ogventer barn. Men da nationens sikkerhed står på spil, må Turner somBig Momma agere barnepige for tre møgunger.

programme.title: Made in America
programme.desc: Da 18-årige Zora (Long), datter af en meget selvstændig, enlig mor og stolt afroamerikaner (Goldberg), erfarer via en blodprøve, at hun ikke er i familie med den for længst afdøde, velrespekterede sorte mand, hun troede var hendes far, gennemsøger hun en sædbanks registre efter sin biologiske far.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone er flyveleder nummer et, indtil en stilfærdig fremmed, Russell Bell, bliver overført til afdelingen. Rivaliseringen mellem de to øverste flyveledere i New York TRACON eskalerer til et potentielt farligt niveau.

programme.title: Joe Somebody
programme.desc: Da en fredelig vatnisse udfordrer kontorets bølle til slåskamp, går han fra at være anonym til at være noget.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace er en almindelig pige som tilfældigvis bliver prinsesse, da en familierejse til Paris ender med at blive til hendes store fantasi. Ved at leve som kongelige, opdager Grace, sammen med sine to bedste venner, hvem hun virkelig er – ved at foregive en andens identitet.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Da en hårdtarbejdende redaktør på The New Yorker (Helen Hunt) følger efter sin søn (Brenton Thwaites) til L.A., efter han er droppet ud af college for at finde sig selv, ender hun med selv at være den, der kastes ud i en fuldstændig forvandling.

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Da en mindre klog pakkeleverandør uforvarende kommer til at levere en pakke, der indeholder skjult kokain, til den forkerte adresse, sætter det gang i en desperat jagt og kamp om kokainen...

programme.title: Then Came You
programme.desc: THEN CAME YOU er historien om Skye (Maisie Williams), en kæk teenager med en dødelig sygdom, og Calvin (Asa Butterfield), en 19 år gammel hypokonder, der er bange for sin egen skygge.

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: Da Marmaduke flytter til et nyt kvarter med sin familie, opdager den kæmpestore teenage-hund hurtigt, at han bare ikke passer ind – bogstaveligt talt! Men med hjælp fra sin bedste ven, katten Carlos, og nogle nye, firbenede venner lykkes det måske alligevel Marmaduke at komme ud af hundehuset...

programme.title: Fat Kid Rules The World
programme.desc: Troy Billings er 17 år gammel, overvægtig og parat til at tage livet af sig selv. Da han prøver at springe ud foran en bus, bliver han reddet af Marcus, en charmerende gademusikant, der er droppet ud af high school.

programme.title: Three Day Millionaire
programme.desc: En hårdtslående komedie om en flok unge fiskere fra den regnvåde nordengelske havn, Grimsby, som skal udføre deres livs kup for at redde byen. Glem Oceans’ 11 og forbered jer på Grimsbys 4.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: FBI-agent Malcolm Turner og hans stedsøn bliver vidne til et mord og går under jorden på en scenekunstskole for piger.

programme.title: Man sku' være noget ved musikken
programme.desc: Handlingen i denne komedie udspiller sig i og omkring værtshuset Café Strudsen på Nørrebro i København med tjeneren Søren (Karl Stegger), servitricen Caja, pianisten Lasse (Otto Brandenburg) og en række stamgæster som hovedpersoner,.

programme.title: Maybe Baby
programme.desc: En komedie om et par (Hugh Laurie og Joely Richardson), der forsøger at undfange et barn.

programme.desc: Rafe Khatchadorian har et efternavn, der er svært at udtale og en imponerende fantasi, og så har han det lidt svært med autoriteter. Han er snarere en engageret knægt end en rebelsk anarkist og er nu på vej til sin seneste første skoledag på sin tredje skole.

programme.title: Joe Somebody
programme.desc: Da en fredelig vatnisse udfordrer kontorets bølle til slåskamp, går han fra at være anonym til at være noget.

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: Elliot Richards er en håbløs, ung mand, som er besat af at finde kærligheden. Desperat efter at ændre sit liv indgår han en pagt med Djævlen, som lover at gøre netop dette - men for en pris.

programme.title: Then Came You
programme.desc: En ensom enke har planlagt at rejse jorden rundt med sin mands aske for at besøge de steder, de faldt for i de forskellige film, de så sammen. Det første stop på rejsen forandrer hendes liv for altid.

Veronica (Winona Ryder) hader de tre Heather-piger, og går sammen med den rebelske Jason Dean (Christian Slater) for at få hævn over de tre piger. Snart tager tingene en morderisk drejning.

programme.title: Shockwave
programme.desc: Når en massiv vulkansk storm rammer verden, forsøger geofysikeren Kate Ferris at overbevise forsvarsministeriet om, at det ikke er et naturligt fænomen. Det er resultatet af en seismisk supermagt, kendt som Hell Storm, som er blevet aktiveret.

programme.title: Sightings
programme.desc: Et science fiction-mysterium om en dysfunktionel familie som bor på en ranch i Texas og trues af en skabning i skoven. For at kunne overleve truslen, bliver de samtidig nødt til at løse sine egne indre konflikter.

programme.title: 13Th District
programme.desc: Paris, 2013. Hardcore ghettokriminalitet har fået regeringen til at isolere de belastede områder bag høje sikkerhedsmure...

programme.desc: En mand vågner på hospitalet uden erindring om, hvem han er, og finder ud af, at han er efterlyst for at have begået en række mord.

programme.title: Tracers

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.desc: Bob Ho er en international superagent, der har prøvet det meste... biljagter, eksplosioner, fald fra høje bygninger... you name it. Men intet kan måle sigmed hans næste store opgave: En weekend som babysitter for hans kærestes tre møgunger!

programme.desc: Opdagelsesrejsende Dirk Pitt med flere tager på det allerstørste eventyr, når de leder efter et jernbeklædt kampskib med hemmelig last i Vestafrika.

programme.title: Joyride
programme.desc: Jon, en ulykkeligt forelsket, men charmerende fiasko på nærmest alle punkter, Luke, en superkører på flugt fra fortiden, og Keira, medarbejder i en burgerrestaurant og veganeraktivist, kommer på kant af loven på deres tur gennem New Zealand i en ”lånt” gul Mini Cooper.

programme.title: TMNT
programme.desc: Splint; rotten sensei; fornemmer, at hans fire teenagere skildpadde-disciple er vokset fra hinanden og har brug for at knytte bånd for at besejre et gammelt monster.

programme.title: The Death & Life Of Bobby Z

programme.desc: Den dobbelte Oscar-vinder Hillary Swank spiller hovedrollen som den succesfulde koncertpianist Kate, der rammes af den uhelbredelige sygdom ALS. Hendes familie tilbyder hende de bedste plejere, men Kate selv falder for den utjekkede og komplet inkompetente Bec.

programme.title: Gensyn med Yorkshire
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison finder ud af, at han har kræft og kun har nogle få uger tilbage at leve i. Hans voksne søn, Blake, rejser til Yorkshire for at bo hos sin mor i den by, han voksede op i. Efterhånden som Arthurs tilstand forværres, ser Blake tilbage på sit forhold til faren.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Den alkoholiserede Matti, der bor under broerne, er ved at arve en betydelig sum penge fra sin amerikanske faster. Men manden skal se præsentabel ud under fasterens besøg. Matti fortæller sin ven, der arbejder som bilforhandler, om situationen, og han foreslår en rollebytte mod kompensation.

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: En krønike om livet for aristokraten Georgiana, hertuginde af Devonshire, fra det 18. århundrede, der var æret for sit ekstravagante politiske og personlige liv.

programme.title: Tusind timer
programme.desc: En historie om kærlighed, identitet, om at tabe og at finde sig selv igen. Tusind timer handler om sangerinden Anna, der er sidst i tyverne og har et band sammen med guitaristen Thomas.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: Mad Money er inspireret af virkelige begivenheder og følger tre meget forskellige kvinder, der arbejder for centralbanken og går sammen om at stjæle gamle pengesedler, der skal makuleres.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Efter seks år som soldat i Den Amerikanske Borgerkrig vender en venligere og mere betænksom soldat hjem til sin gård og kone, som ellers troede, han var død. En skuffet bejler afslører, at manden er en bedrager, og at den rigtige Sommersby er efterlyst for mord.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: I et skyggefuldt område af virksomhedsspionage snubler en kedet allemand ind i et net af bedrag og bliver en uvidende spion. Mens han navigerer i forræderi og forræderi, samarbejder han med en forførende gåde for at afsløre chokerende sandheder og genvinde sin identitet.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman ( Seven, Red, Batman Begins) kendt men aldrende skuespiller møder på sin research til en ny rolle en smuk spansk kassedame, der er mere end træt af sit job, som består i at servicere de kunder som har 10 eller færre varer.

programme.title: Hercules In New York
programme.desc: Hercules (Arnold Schwarzenegger) er forvist fra Mount Olympus og sendes til Jorden, hvor han finder ægte kærlighed og starter en lovende karriere i bodybuilder-branchen.

programme.title: Lindell: Drømmefangeren - Del 1
programme.desc: Drømmefangeren er en uudholdeligt spændende krimi, hvor de psykologiske undertoner driver handlingen frem, til det hele ender i et dramatisk kapløb mod en iskold morder. Hvem er voyeuren, som står i vinduet og betragter de unge kvinder i lejligheden overfor?

programme.title: Edison
programme.desc: En af politiets eliteenheder risikerer at blive afsløret i korruption af en ung journalist, som hurtigt opdager, at han er på dybt vand.

programme.title: W.
programme.desc: Fra drukfester og detentionsbesøg til genfødt kristen. Fra sort guld i Texas’ oliefelter til det Hvide Hus i Washington. Fra kampen ud af sin fars skygge til krigen inde bag fjendens linjer i Irak. Her er den utrolige historie om USA’s 43. præsident.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: Kærlighed overvinder alt ... selv den uimodståelige trang til at spise din kærestes hjernemasse! I en ikke så fjern fremtid er jorden befolket af lige dele menneskeædende zombier og zombiebekæmpende mennesker.

programme.title: Death At A Funeral
programme.desc: For de fleste er begravelser bare noget, der skal overstås, og hvis det stod til Daniel, så sprang han gerne denne dag over, hvor hans far skal stedes til hvile.

programme.title: Miraklet i Le Havre
programme.desc: I den finske film 'Miraklet i Le Havre' har den tidligere forfatter og nuværende boheme Marcel Marx slået sig ned i den nordfranske havneby Le Havre. Her lever han et stille liv mellem bistroen, arbejdet og kæresten Arletty. En dag lander den afrikanske dreng Idrissa på hans dørtrin.

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: Dette hårde drama følger to gymnasiekammerater, Hancock og Danny, efter at de er færdige. Hancock og hans cheerleader-kæreste går videre til en middelklasse-middelmådighed, der ligger uden for rækkevidde for Danny og hans psykotiske kone Bev.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: En advokat, der er gjort blind af radioaktivt affald, bekæmper forbrydelse som en akrobastisk, kampsport superhelt ved hjælp af de sine andre sanser, som er blevet stærkere.

programme.title: The Birdcage
programme.desc: Armand og Albert bygget det perfekte liv for sig selv ved at passe deres natklub i Miami. Men deres pastelfarvede ro bliver rystet, da Armands søn annoncerer, at han skal giftes med datteren til den ultrakonservative senator Keeley... og de skal alle spise middag sammen!

programme.title: Laws of Attraction
programme.desc: Dygtige skilsmisseadvokater; Audrey Woods og Daniel Rafferty; har set kærligheden gå galt i alle dens værste tilfælde - så hvor dårlige kan deres chancer være?

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Velkommen til en katolsk pigeskole i hjertet af Chicago, byen som er hjem for USA's mest populære danseshow: Dance TV! Udvekslingsstudenten Janey Glenn er et nervevrag, da hun bliver præsenteret for sine fnisende klassekammerater af den strenge søster Katherine.

programme.title: Håbet er lysegrønt
programme.desc: Efter 30 års ægteskab deltager et midaldrende ægtepar i en intens, ugelang terapisession for at arbejde på deres forhold.

programme.title: Blackbird
programme.desc: En familie på tre generationer samles en weekend for at tilbringe en sidste stund sammen med deres dødeligt syge mor Lily. Konflikterne ulmer under overfladen mellem Lilys døtre Jennifer og Anna, og dybt begravede hemmeligheder truer alle håb om et fredeligt farvel.

programme.title: Lindell: Drømmefangeren - Del 2
programme.desc: Drømmefangeren er en uudholdeligt spændende krimi, hvor de psykologiske undertoner driver handlingen frem, til det hele ender i et dramatisk kapløb mod en iskold morder. Hvem er voyeuren, som står i vinduet og betragter de unge kvinder i lejligheden overfor?

programme.title: Rules Don't Apply
programme.desc: Rules Don't Apply, der er instrueret af Beatty og baseret på en historie af Beatty og Bo Goldman, er fuldt stjernebesat med bl.a. Annette Bening og Matthew Broderick.
